$:set -euo pipefail
printf 'HEAD=%s
' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
for f in workspaces/AGENTS.md workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/AGENTS.md workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/README.md; do if test -f "$f"; then printf '
FOUND %s
' "$f"; cat "$f"; elif test -e "$f"; then printf '
EXISTS_NONFILE %s
' "$f"; else printf '
ABSENT %s
' "$f"; fi; done
if test -d workspaces; then printf '
WORKSPACES_DIR=present
'; else printf '
WORKSPACES_DIR=missing
'; exit 3; fi
